entities.summary: The Euro-Mediterranean University of Fez (UEMF) is a university located in Fez, Morocco. The university was created to foster academic cooperation between countries of the Euro-Mediterranean region. The project was approved by the Union for the Mediterranean (UfM) in 2012, and the institution officially opened in 2014.
